description: Finds official city and county automated license plate reader matters in the MORVS License Plate Reader Register. Returns selected published decision fields with complete recorded action timelines, source links, vendors named in titles, and dollar figures exactly as printed. Filter by state, jurisdiction, vendor, recorded motion outcome, subject, decisive-action year or title substring query. Outcome means only the motion as recorded. An approval is an authorization, not proof of a signed contract or installed camera. A failed motion does not mean a contract ended. Amounts are printed figures, often ceilings, never money spent. No row means no qualifying action was found in the checked sources and period; it is not proof that no ALPR use exists.

disposition.description: Recorded motion outcome code. Approved means authorization; a motion that did not carry does not mean a contract ended.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction client slug or case-insensitive name substring; no row means no qualifying action was found in sources checked.

limit.description: Maximum decisions returned; default 25, allowed 1-100. Amounts are printed figures, often ceilings, not money spent.

query.description: Case-insensitive title substring, at most 80 characters.

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code, e.g. TX. A state with no row means no qualifying action was found in sources checked.

subject.description: Register subject code from the matter title; it describes the topic, not the outcome.

vendor.description: Exact vendor name from the register; a named vendor does not prove a signed contract or installed cameras.

year.description: Four-digit year of the decisive recorded action.

name: plate_reader_decisions
title: Find Plate Reader Decisions
